Equipment:
 Blow Down Drain Sump 
 Pumps for Main Boiler

This document out lines the major 
maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block

The function 
of the blow down drain sump 
 pumps for main boiler:

The first draft initiated by eng. Gamal El-Sayed 
El-Osily, reviewed by maintenance manger eng. Sobhey Abdel Haleem, revised by 
EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Samir
Abd-Elgalil, accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel Khaffar
Al-Arish Power Station general manager, approved by 
eng Yousry Mohamed Salama head sector and certified by eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy 
EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear 
 the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety glasses,... 
 etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction
valves
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction
valves
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.
Two complete maintenance tools sets
Cleaning fluid, manual pullers
Straight edge, rages
Small wire brush, filter gauge.
Chain, lifting hock, dial gauge
Remove the delivery pipe connection.
Disconnect the motor unscrew the bolts and take out the motor.
Remove the lubricating pipes (562.1, 562.2).

Remove the coupling nuts and pins (404) alone with the coupling bushes (400) 
 and coupling washer
Remove the coupling (390) by using suitable puller.
Remove the bearing cover (270-1) by unscrewing the bolts.
Unscrew the two bearing nuts (335/336).
Remove thrust bearing .
Loosen the foundation bolts of motor stool and support plats.
Unscrew the pipe nut (338) take out the support plate (383).

Life the entire pump unit with the help of bolts and fit clamp to the top 
 column pipe (132) and pipe (142.2)
Remove strainer (216)
Disconnect the bend (280) and lubricating pipe (562.1)
Loosen the nut holding casing cover (220).
Take out casing cover from the impeller and shaft assembly.

Hold other end of the shaft by spanner and unscrew the impeller screw (669) by 
 using Allen key.
Pull out the impeller (151) remove impeller key.
Disconnect bell month.
Remove impeller shaft sleeve (311) alone its key.

sections.text: Inspect the bearings and replace them if necessary.
Check all parts for any worn out.
Inspect the run out of shaft.

items: Inspect the bearings and replace them if necessary.
Replace the worn out parts.
Check all parts for any worn out.
Inspect the run out of shaft.
Put the impeller shaft slave (311) on pump shaft (185) .

Slide impeller on shaft and tighten the impeller screw (669) with its gasket 
 (682) by using Allen key
Fix bearing covers (271) with oil seals to casing cover .

Fix bell mouth (211) on pump casing (107) and tighten diametrically opposite 
 nuts one by one .
Insert casing cover.

Inspect the whole assembly so far mad into pump casing with gasket in proper 
 position .
Mount the top column pipe on casing cover.
Connect pipe nipple.
Make further pipe connection up to nipple.
Connect bend and rising pipe to pump casing.
Lift the unit vertically.
Mount strainer (216) on bell mouth.

Lift the motor stool (290) and fix it to the top column pipe (132) at the same 
 time fix the lubricating pipe.
Fix the support plate (383) on the foundation.
Tighten the foundation bolls of motor stool.
Check the level on the machine surface of motor stool.

Fix the cover for bearing bush alone with oil seal (270-2) , (500.2) to the 
 thrust bearing (247) .
Fit the thrust bearing carrier to motor stool.
